description: This file defines a command-line 'ServeCommand' that runs the Swabble speech processing application, handling configuration, speech streaming, wake word detection, and logging.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command that runs the Swabble server, managing speech streams, wake word detection, and logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously executes the main logic of the ServeCommand, including loading config, starting speech pipeline, processing streams, and handling errors.

methods.name: matchesWake
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the configured wake word or its aliases.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes the wake word or aliases from the beginning of the input text.
